name: crypto.x509
doc:
The Zell-source crypto.x509 (see sema/stdsrc.rs for the rules):
X.509 v3 certificates (RFC 5280) in DER and PEM, private keys (PKCS#8,
PKCS#1, SEC 1), chain building and verification against a pool of
roots, hostname matching (SAN dNSName with left-most wildcards, IP
addresses), validity periods, basic constraints, key usage, extended
key usage and the dNSName part of name constraints. Signature checks use
the C primitives of crypto.{rsa,ecdsa,ed25519}. Times are Unix
milliseconds (time).

items.name: DecodePEM
items.doc:
DecodePEM returns every PEM block of text in order (text outside blocks
is ignored); a block with invalid base64 is an error.
items.summary: DecodePEM returns every PEM block of text in order (text outside blocks is ignored); a block with invalid base64 is an error.

items.name: EncodePEM
items.doc: EncodePEM formats der as one PEM block of the given type.
items.summary: EncodePEM formats der as one PEM block of the given type.

items.name: ParsePEM
items.doc:
ParsePEM parses every CERTIFICATE block of text (other blocks are
skipped); it fails if there is none or one is invalid.
items.summary: ParsePEM parses every CERTIFICATE block of text (other blocks are skipped); it fails if there is none or one is invalid.

items.name: ParsePrivateKey
items.doc: ParsePrivateKey parses a DER private key: PKCS#8, PKCS#1 (RSA) or SEC 1 (EC).
items.summary: ParsePrivateKey parses a DER private key: PKCS#8, PKCS#1 (RSA) or SEC 1 (EC).

items.name: ParsePrivateKeyPEM
items.doc:
ParsePrivateKeyPEM parses the first PRIVATE KEY, RSA PRIVATE KEY or EC
PRIVATE KEY block of text.
items.summary: ParsePrivateKeyPEM parses the first PRIVATE KEY, RSA PRIVATE KEY or EC PRIVATE KEY block of text.

items.name: SystemRoots
items.doc:
SystemRoots loads the operating system's trusted roots. They are parsed
once per process and reused while the bundle's path, size and
modification time stay the same (parsing a distribution bundle takes
milliseconds, which every TLS dial paid before); each call returns its
own pool (a copy of the cached one), so adding to it is safe.
items.summary: SystemRoots loads the operating system's trusted roots.

items.name: SystemRootsPath
items.doc:
SystemRootsPath is the PEM bundle used by SystemRoots ($SSL_CERT_FILE or
the distribution's bundle; "" if there is none).
items.summary: SystemRootsPath is the PEM bundle used by SystemRoots ($SSL_CERT_FILE or the distribution's bundle; "" if there is none).

items.name: Verify
items.doc:
Verify builds a chain from cert to one of the roots and checks it:
signatures, validity periods, CA flags and path lengths, key usage,
extended key usage, dNSName name constraints and the host name. It
returns the chain, leaf first, root last.
items.summary: Verify builds a chain from cert to one of the roots and checks it: signatures, validity periods, CA flags and path lengths, key usage, extended key usage, dNSName name constraints and the host name.

items.doc: One attribute of a distinguished name.
items.summary: One attribute of a distinguished name.

members.doc: Dotted OID ("2.5.4.3").
members.summary: Dotted OID ("2.5.4.3").

items.name: CertPool
items.doc: CertPool is a set of certificates (trust anchors or intermediates).
items.summary: CertPool is a set of certificates (trust anchors or intermediates).

members.name: AppendPEM
members.doc:
AppendPEM adds every certificate of a PEM text (invalid ones are
skipped) and returns how many were added.
members.summary: AppendPEM adds every certificate of a PEM text (invalid ones are skipped) and returns how many were added.

items.name: Certificate
items.doc: Certificate is a parsed X.509 certificate.
items.summary: Certificate is a parsed X.509 certificate.

members.name: Raw
members.doc: The whole DER encoding and the signed part.
members.summary: The whole DER encoding and the signed part.

members.name: SerialNumber
members.doc: Serial number, lower-case hex of the big-endian magnitude.
members.summary: Serial number, lower-case hex of the big-endian magnitude.

members.name: NotBefore
members.doc: Validity period, Unix milliseconds.
members.summary: Validity period, Unix milliseconds.

members.name: PublicKeyAlgorithm
members.doc: "RSA", "ECDSA" or "Ed25519".
members.summary: "RSA", "ECDSA" or "Ed25519".

members.name: PublicKey
members.doc:
EC point (65 bytes, uncompressed) or Ed25519 key (32 bytes); for RSA
the modulus (PublicKey) and exponent (RSAExponent), big-endian.
members.summary: EC point (65 bytes, uncompressed) or Ed25519 key (32 bytes); for RSA the modulus (PublicKey) and exponent (RSAExponent), big-endian.

members.name: Curve
members.doc: "P-256", "P-384", "P-521" for ECDSA keys.
members.summary: "P-256", "P-384", "P-521" for ECDSA keys.

members.name: SignatureAlgorithm
members.doc: E.g. "SHA256-RSA", "SHA384-RSAPSS", "ECDSA-SHA256", "Ed25519".
members.summary: E.g.

members.name: MaxPathLen
members.doc: -1 if absent.
members.summary: -1 if absent.

members.name: KeyUsage
members.doc: 0 if the extension is absent (see the bit list above).
members.summary: 0 if the extension is absent (see the bit list above).

members.name: ExtKeyUsage
members.doc:
"serverAuth", "clientAuth", "codeSigning", "emailProtection",
"timeStamping", "OCSPSigning", "any" or the dotted OID.
members.summary: "serverAuth", "clientAuth", "codeSigning", "emailProtection", "timeStamping", "OCSPSigning", "any" or the dotted OID.

members.name: IPAddresses
members.doc: Dotted IPv4 or RFC 5952-ish IPv6 text.
members.summary: Dotted IPv4 or RFC 5952-ish IPv6 text.

members.name: UnhandledCriticalExtensions
members.doc:
OIDs of critical extensions this parser does not understand
(Verify rejects such certificates).
members.summary: OIDs of critical extensions this parser does not understand (Verify rejects such certificates).

members.name: Fingerprint
members.doc: Hex of the SHA-256 of Raw.
members.summary: Hex of the SHA-256 of Raw.

members.name: VerifyHostname
members.doc:
VerifyHostname checks that the certificate is valid for host (a DNS
name, or an IP address matched against the IP SANs).
members.summary: VerifyHostname checks that the certificate is valid for host (a DNS name, or an IP address matched against the IP SANs).

members.name: CheckSignatureFrom
members.doc: CheckSignatureFrom checks that parent signed this certificate.
members.summary: CheckSignatureFrom checks that parent signed this certificate.

members.name: CheckSignature
members.signature: func CheckSignature(algorithm string, signed []byte, sig []byte) void!
members.summary: CheckSignature checks sig over signed with this certificate's key, for a certificate-style algorithm name ("SHA256-RSA", "ECDSA-SHA256", "SHA256-RSAPSS", "Ed25519").

items.name: Name
items.doc: Name is a distinguished name with the common attributes broken out.
items.summary: Name is a distinguished name with the common attributes broken out.

members.name: Names
members.doc: Every attribute in order.
members.summary: Every attribute in order.

members.name: Raw

members.summary: The DER encoding (compared byte for byte when building chains).

members.summary: RFC 4514-style string, most specific attribute first ("CN=a,O=b,C=c").

items.name: PrivateKey
items.doc: PrivateKey is a parsed private key.
items.summary: PrivateKey is a parsed private key.

members.name: Algorithm
members.doc: "RSA", "ECDSA" (P-256) or "Ed25519".
members.summary: "RSA", "ECDSA" (P-256) or "Ed25519".

members.name: Bytes
members.doc:
RSA: the PKCS#1 RSAPrivateKey DER; ECDSA: the 32-byte scalar;
Ed25519: the 32-byte seed.
members.summary: RSA: the PKCS#1 RSAPrivateKey DER; ECDSA: the 32-byte scalar; Ed25519: the 32-byte seed.

members.name: Public
members.doc: RSA: modulus; ECDSA: 65-byte point; Ed25519: 32-byte key.
members.summary: RSA: modulus; ECDSA: 65-byte point; Ed25519: 32-byte key.

members.name: Matches
members.doc: True if the key belongs to the certificate's public key.
members.summary: True if the key belongs to the certificate's public key.

members.name: DNSName
members.doc: Host name (or IP) the leaf must be valid for; "" skips the check.
members.summary: Host name (or IP) the leaf must be valid for; "" skips the check.

members.name: Roots
members.doc: Trust anchors; nil means SystemRoots().
members.summary: Trust anchors; nil means SystemRoots().

members.name: Intermediates
members.doc: Extra certificates that may be used as intermediates.
members.summary: Extra certificates that may be used as intermediates.

members.name: CurrentTime
members.doc: Unix ms to check validity at; 0 means now.
members.summary: Unix ms to check validity at; 0 means now.

members.name: KeyUsage
members.doc:
Required extended key usage of the leaf: "serverAuth" (default when
""), "clientAuth", or "any".
members.summary: Required extended key usage of the leaf: "serverAuth" (default when ""), "clientAuth", or "any".
